import json, random, sys, time, math
from fractions import Fraction
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor')
import controller, probability

def make(nslots, nwindows, nflows, seed=7):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    case = {"model": 'cnn',
            "class_values":[rng.randint(1,1000) for _ in range(7)],
            "stats":[rng.randint(1,1000)]*3,
            "bucket":[min(64,nslots),min(64,nslots)],
            "slots":[[t*10, rng.randint(0,4), 0 if i==0 else rng.randint(0,3)] for i,t in enumerate(range(nslots))],
            "flows":[[rng.randint(1,4), rng.randint(4,8), -1, rng.randint(0,6)] for _ in range(nflows)],
            "groups":[],
            "windows":[[rng.randrange(nflows), rng.randint(0,50), rng.randint(50,nslots*10), rng.randint(1,65535),
                        rng.randint(1,320), rng.randint(0,65535), rng.randint(1,1000),
                        [[rng.randint(0,1500), rng.randint(0,2560)] for _ in range(9)]] for _ in range(nwindows)]}
    return {"version":3,"cases":[case]}

req = make(60,200,8)
c = controller._parse(json.dumps(req).encode())[0]
thr = probability.window_thresholds(c['stats'], c['windows'])
cv=c['class_values']
values=[c['windows'][j][6]*cv[0] for j in range(len(c['windows']))]
elig=[c['windows'][j][5]<thr[j] for j in range(len(c['windows']))]
model=controller._build_arcs(c,values,elig)
feas=controller._Feasibility(model)
targets=[f[0] for f in c['flows']]
cands=sorted({Fraction(k,t) for t in targets for k in range(t+1)})
lo,hi=0,len(cands)-1;best=0
while lo<=hi:
    mid=(lo+hi)//2
    ok,_,_=feas.run([math.ceil(cands[mid]*t) for t in targets])
    if ok: best=mid; lo=mid+1
    else: hi=mid-1
ratio=cands[best]
lower=[math.ceil(ratio*t) for t in targets]
feas.run(lower); ff=feas.original_flow()
working=[(arc[0],arc[1],0,arc[3],arc[4]) for arc in model['arcs']]
for f in range(model['flow_count']):
    p=model['flow_arc'][f]; cur=working[p]; working[p]=(cur[0],cur[1],lower[f],cur[3],cur[4])
circ=controller._Circulation(model['nodes'],working)
flow=[working[i][2]+ff[i] for i in range(len(working))]
t0=time.time(); it=0; total_cost=0
while True:
    cycle,dist=circ.negative_cycle(flow)
    if cycle is None: break
    # cycle cost
    ccost = sum(circ.res_cost[e] for e in cycle)
    total_cost += ccost
    circ.augment(cycle,flow); it+=1
    if it>400: break
el=time.time()-t0
print('iterations %d  time %.2f  per-iter %.4f  total cycle cost %d' % (it, el, el/it, total_cost))
PYEOF
